name: Hidden Run
body:
You are a fleeting shadow, nearly invisible even as you rush past opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Acrobatics 6 ranks, Stealth 6 ranks

Benefit: You may move up to your normal speed with no penalty to your Stealth check.
